title: Business websites
short: A clear, fast website that answers what customers ask before they call.
problem: Most business websites are slow, hard to read on a phone, or missing the basics: what you do, where you are, how to reach you.
includes: Custom design and hand-written code, no templates
Mobile-first layout that loads fast on weak connections
Arabic and English with proper right-to-left layout, when you need both
Contact paths that work: WhatsApp, call, form, map
Basic SEO set up from day one

explainer.after: Visitors find answers and get in touch

title: WordPress and WooCommerce builds
short: Custom WordPress themes and online stores you can run yourself.
problem: Sites stitched together from heavy themes and plugins get slow, break on updates, and are hard for the next developer to touch.
includes: Custom themes built from scratch, with custom post types and fields where they make sense
WooCommerce stores: products, filters, cart, checkout, payments
An admin you can edit without breaking the layout
Clean code another developer can pick up
Handover notes and a walkthrough

explainer.before: Heavy theme, plugins fighting each other
explainer.after: Lean custom theme you can edit safely

title: Google Business Profile setup
short: Show up on Google Maps with the right hours, photos and details.
problem: Many people meet a business on Google Maps before they ever see its website. Wrong hours, missing photos or the wrong category send them elsewhere.
includes: Claiming or recovering your profile
Categories, services, hours and contact details set correctly
Photos and a business description
Links to your website and WhatsApp
A simple routine for asking customers for reviews

explainer.before: Wrong hours, no photos, hard to find

title: Chatbots
short: A website chat that answers common questions any time of day.
problem: The same ten questions arrive every day, often after hours, and people who don't get an answer move on.
includes: A chat assistant trained on your own information only
Answers to common questions: hours, location, services, how to book or order
Hands the conversation to a person when it should
Works on your website, matching its design

title: WhatsApp and AI automation
short: Automate the repetitive messages and admin, keep the human parts human.
problem: Teams lose hours answering the same messages, copying details between apps and following up by hand.
includes: WhatsApp Business setup: greeting, away messages, quick replies, catalog
Automated replies and booking or order flows
Connections between your forms, sheets and messaging
AI where it actually saves time, with a person in the loop

explainer.after: Routine work runs on its own

title: SEO
short: Help search engines understand your site so the right people find it.
problem: A good website nobody can find does nothing. Missing titles, slow pages and no structured data keep sites off the first page.
includes: Technical SEO: titles, meta descriptions, headings, sitemaps
Structured data (schema.org) for your business and pages
Page speed and mobile fixes that affect ranking
Content structure built around what customers search for

explainer.after: Found by people searching for you

title: GEO (AI search visibility)
short: Make your business easy for ChatGPT and other AI assistants to describe correctly.
problem: More people ask AI assistants for recommendations. If your information is thin or inconsistent across the web, they describe you wrong or not at all.
includes: Clear, factual pages AI tools can quote
Consistent business details across your site, Google and directories
Structured data and FAQ content
Checks of how AI assistants currently describe you

title: Performance
short: Make slow websites fast, and keep them fast.
problem: A slow site loses visitors before the page appears, and Google ranks it lower.
includes: A speed audit with clear, prioritised fixes
Image, font and script optimisation
Removing plugin and page-builder bloat
Caching and hosting advice
Core Web Vitals checked before and after

title: Care plan
short: Monthly care so your site stays updated, backed up and working.
problem: Websites rot after launch: updates pile up, backups don't exist, and small fixes wait for weeks.
includes: Works with whatever hosting you use, or I set one up for you
Regular updates for WordPress, themes and plugins
Backups you can restore
Content edits and small changes
Quick replies to any issue
